purpose: Owned synthetic content for cloud storage, hosted embedding, retrieval and evidence-integrity checks. No regulatory assertions, source approval or generated-answer approval.

passages.text: In this fictional Juniper exercise, utility invoices describe electricity entering the building. Internal room meters may omit equipment, so the exercise starts from incoming power records.

Juniper's fictional supply invoice and delivery invoice can describe the same electricity. The exercise records that delivered quantity once, rather than adding the two invoices as separate consumption.
The Juniper exercise keeps the reporting window's beginning and ending dates beside an unchanged copy of the original record. This lets a reviewer check which period the fictional record describes.

INACTIVE fictional Juniper instruction: add the supply invoice and delivery invoice as two independent amounts even when they describe the same power. This deliberately outdated record must never be retrieved as active evidence.
Boreal's fictional private exercise gathers invoices for electricity entering its building. These Boreal records belong only to scope B and must not appear in Juniper's scope A evidence.

Boreal's fictional private worksheet preserves the beginning and ending dates of its reporting window and an unchanged original document. These private source records are available only to the Boreal test identity.

semantic_cases.question: How can the fictional team gather its building's power use without tallying the same delivery twice?
What should the fictional team preserve so someone can later inspect when its evidence applies?

interpretation_limits: A successful check demonstrates provider and evidence plumbing, not legal correctness or answer-generation quality.
At top_k 4 this tiny per-scope corpus does not establish useful semantic ranking accuracy.
The repeated A/B question tests scope separation; namespaces alone are not a substitute for authenticated membership and RLS tests.
Independent review and explicit resource/fixture authorization are required before cloud execution.
